item.title: [Tempering] Self-Debugging My Place in the Embedded Stack
item.description: A self-debugging record: I used engineering stress tests to resolve my confusion about where I fit in the embedded stack. I confirmed that instead of obsessing over bottom-layer registers, I’m strongest in the middle layer—where data flow, validation, and embedded algorithms live.
